Name: Abihail, Wife of Abishur
Summary: Wife of Abishur and mother of Ahban and Molid.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:29: Wife of Abishur and mother of Ahban and Molid.
LifeLesson: The mention of Abihail in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
